name: James–Potts 2018 experimental steel-tip dart
description: Reconstruction of the paper's experimental dart, not a Target Bolide replica. Measured assembled mass and balance override geometry-only mass estimates.

barrel.name: 80% tungsten alloy
barrel.status: composition and effective metal-assembly density reported in paper; exact binder and bore unknown

point.name: steel
point.status: conventional steel-tip reconstruction; steel grade and heat treatment unmeasured

stem.name: nylon
stem.status: material and effective density reported in paper

flights.name: thin polymer sheet
flights.status: sheet polymer chemistry and thickness not reported; rigid-sheet approximation

evidence.transverse_inertia: Inferred by rearranging the paper's equation 32 using reported M_alpha, static margin, area and normal-force slope; not a direct inertia measurement.
evidence.axial_inertia: Derived from the approximate component geometry and estimated tail mass partition; not measured.

randomization_note: Mass range follows the reported mass spread. All other bounds are engineering robustness assumptions, not measured confidence intervals. Refit to the actual hardware dart before claiming transfer accuracy.
